scope: Implement Mujun Cue Phase 1 inside MU Desk: Focus Hold, pointer guidance, spotlight, local magnifier, live/frozen annotation baseline, screenshots, unified toolbar/settings/tray/pause/recovery integration, and focused tests.
owned_areas: Cue settings and normalization in Toolbox.Core
Cue module, hooks, magnification interop, overlay/toolbar/settings/annotation/screenshot surfaces in Toolbox.App
Minimum MU Desk homepage, tray, pause, shutdown and settings wiring
Code-native Cue module icon and focused settings/core tests
preserve: MU Desk remains the only shell, executable, tray, startup identity, settings owner and package.
All existing modules, data formats, entry points and compatibility launchers remain behaviorally unchanged.
No screen content is uploaded or logged and no administrator privilege is introduced.
Dynamic Capture remains a separate short-motion capture module.
sequence: Add normalized Cue settings and backward-compatible ToolboxSettings migration.
Implement one module lifecycle with global keyboard hook, fullscreen magnification cleanup and emergency reset.
Implement per-monitor click-through pointer/spotlight overlays and on-demand local magnifier.
Implement the compact toolbar, annotation baseline and screenshot commands.
Wire homepage, tray, shared pause, shutdown and unified errors without changing existing module behavior.
Add focused tests, build, publish and run representative smoke checks; record limitations honestly.

risks.risk: Global keyboard interception could break Caps Lock or remain active after failure.
risks.mitigation: Use a single owned low-level hook, forward short taps, always unhook on pause/dispose, and expose four independent recovery paths.

risks.risk: Windows fullscreen magnification differs across monitor/DPI/input configurations.
risks.mitigation: Clamp transforms, center on real cursor coordinates, restore 1x before every shutdown path, and keep a visible local-lens fallback.

risks.risk: Capturing a live magnifier can recursively capture its own overlay.
risks.mitigation: Exclude overlay windows from capture where supported, keep refresh on demand, and fail visibly rather than showing stale success.

risks.risk: The first phase is broad enough to destabilize existing modules.
risks.mitigation: Keep Cue code isolated behind one module coordinator and add only narrow host wiring plus regression builds/tests.

verification: Core settings defaults, clamping and legacy JSON compatibility pass.
Caps Lock short tap is preserved; hold activates and release restores Focus Hold.
Emergency reset and MU Desk pause close overlays and restore 1x.
Pointer, spotlight, lens, annotation and screenshot each have one representative working path.
Build and all existing test executables pass without new warnings.
Published MU Desk remains one package and shows the Mujun Cue module card using the inherited visual system.
